data.title: Exclusive: Marex plans to accept Bitcoin, Ethereum as initial margin this year
data.description: Investing.com -- Marex Group (NASDAQ: MRX) plans to begin accepting Bitcoin and Ethereum as initial margin collateral for derivatives later this year, extending its stablecoin program announced last month, Investing.com has learned.
data.keywords: Stephen Hood, initial margin, Marex, Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC
